exams.name: Fundamentals of Engineering Examination
exams.notes: Must be passed before the Principles and Practice examination; an engineer intern or surveyor intern certificate is issued upon passing.
exams.jurisdiction: national (NCEES / national council of examiners for engineering and surveying)
exams.quote: Every person applying for registration as a professional engineer or professional surveyor shall be required to pass the fundamentals examination and the principles and practice examination as provided in section 4733.13 of the Revised Code.

exams.name: Principles and Practice of Engineering Examination
exams.notes: Tests knowledge of the applicant's branch of engineering; branches correspond to those for which examinations are offered by the board or NCEES.
exams.jurisdiction: national (NCEES / national council of examiners for engineering and surveying)
exams.quote: An examination referred to as the principles and practice of engineering examination shall test the applicant's knowledge of the branch of engineering in which the applicant specializes.

requirements.quote: Notwithstanding section 4796.05 of the Revised Code, the board shall register a person who has satisfactory work experience as a professional engineer or surveyor in accordance with Chapter 4796. of the Revised Code if the person satisfies a minimum education requirement and passes an examination.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: No firm, partnership, association, limited liability company, or corporation ... shall engage in providing professional engineering or professional surveying services ... unless the firm, partnership, association, limited liability company, or corporation obtains a certificate of authorization from the state board of registration for professional engineers and surveyors

definition_quote.value: The practice of engineering includes any professional service, such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, design, or inspection of construction or operation for the purpose of assuring compliance with drawings or specifications in connection with any public or privately owned public utilities, structures, buildings, machines, equipment, processes, works, or projects in the proper rendering of which the qualifications of section 4733.11 of the Revised Code are required to protect the public welfare or to safeguard life, health, or property.
definition_quote.quote: "The practice of engineering" includes any professional service, such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, design, or inspection of construction or operation for the purpose of assuring compliance with drawings or specifications in connection with any public or privately owned public utilities, structures, buildings, machines, equipment, processes, works, or projects in the proper rendering of which the qualifications of section 4733.11 of the Revised Code are required to protect the public welfare or to safeguard life, health, or property.

exemptions_from_licensure.quote: The following persons are exempt from this chapter: (a) An employee or a subordinate of a person registered under this chapter ... (b) Officers and employees of the government of the United States ... (c) An engineer engaged solely as an officer of a privately owned public utility.

code_of_ethics_in_statute.quote: The board shall cause to have prepared and shall adopt a code of ethics, which it shall make known to every registrant. The board may revise and amend this code of ethics from time to time in accordance with Chapter 119. of the Revised Code.

pdh_carryover_max_units.quote: A registrant who completes more than thirty hours of approved coursework or activities in a biennial renewal period may carry forward to the next biennial renewal period a maximum of fifteen of the excess hours.
